labels: Paired complete Z/F/G outcomes for confirmation only; all censored episodes retained
role: One finite frozen-model two-task expansion; no refit, threshold search, replacement or repeated extension
no_trigger: Keep all records; no decision label if shared candidate onset not reached
partial: Keep failure/censored; never classify incomplete outcomes as failure
blocks: Separate processes and private compilation; same sampler and seeds for paired Z/F inside a block; reverse condition order between blocks

place_empty_cup.selection: Per task: numerically first existing L0-success seed and first existing L0-failure seed; no candidate-outcome or residual-based selection. Stratified attribution diagnostic, not representative success-rate estimation.

beat_block_hammer.selection: Per task: numerically first existing L0-success seed and first existing L0-failure seed; no candidate-outcome or residual-based selection. Stratified attribution diagnostic, not representative success-rate estimation.

stop_rule: Complete fixed 32 attempts per task and both blocks; invalid scenes never replaced; no outcome-driven stopping
preservation: All fit/calibration/old confirmation scenes excluded. This panel cannot enter refitting or threshold selection.
primary_comparison: Frozen G_candidate_cost2 vs contemporaneous Z_zero; retain F_first_full and G_observation_cost2
success_criteria: Report each task and independent process: net rescue-minus-harm, base-success preservation, selection coverage and paired scene outcomes. No post-hoc winner/threshold selection.
candidate_scope: One original ARM-only F chunk or exact base; rejection consumes sole opportunity; not new-task transfer
probability_scope: Uncalibrated scores; no safety probability claim
source_panel: New expansion only; report independently of the already viewed 501500-501515 confirmation panel

next_task_progression.interpretation: Prospective research progression screen, not statistical significance or safety guarantee

reporting: whole-scene clustered uncertainty with both process repeats retained
local_scope: Expert eligibility only; VLA formal expansion externally on GPU0
uncertainty: Fixed finite robustness panel; no claim of sufficient power or calibrated risk probability
